g.text: Synthetic capacity check; one observation per method. Compressed methods retain 25% of full-attention KV.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Bars in the first panel show stored KV after compaction; recurrent/convolution state remains 49.5 MiB.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Recovery temporarily restores all KV. Total VRAM is sampled every 10 ms and at forward boundaries; no reserved KV pool.
